ticket.description: One of twelve tools emits spans and only for provider completions, so the panel observes inference and nothing else, while telemetry is meant to be suite-wide: observability plus the metadata half of the training corpus. Shape: one span per CLI invocation from a shared helper in gaugeblock-workspace called at each main boundary (binary, command, repo, branch, task_key when a claim is held, duration, status, first diagnostic), plus nested spans for sub-operations joined by trace_id and parent_span_id, which sawhorse already mints correctly. Payloads stay out by design: no prompt or completion text, and the join to the spool is span.task_key, so training data comes from spool records joined to spans rather than from the spans themselves. Retention becomes configurable (max_bytes, keep_rotations, retain) with raw logs untracked and rotated; tracked retained aggregates are a deliberate exception and stay disabled until more than one tool emits.
